product_boundary: Only the five coverage-matrix gaps: compact, festival, club, artifact and collection cards.

families.responsive_behavior: Desktop compact recommendation row uses bounded 5:4 visual treatment; mobile visual remains 5:4 while document media keeps natural aspect.
families.explicit_difference_from_eventcard: Recommendation-density card omits EventCard's full date/calendar/action stack and uses related-card row packing; it is not an EventCard clone.

families.responsive_behavior: Timeline rows retain category/date/status identity; mobile card media treatment follows source semantic class.
families.explicit_difference_from_eventcard: Festival identity is edition/status/source-led and has no EventCard admission/calendar/action anatomy.

families.responsive_behavior: Three-column fact grid collapses to two; source keyboard and focus semantics remain desktop-visible.
families.explicit_difference_from_eventcard: Club card represents an enduring interest group and catalogue activity, not a scheduled EventCard occurrence.

families.responsive_behavior: Rail artifact and collection slot retain local-device collection semantics; motion is removed for reduced-motion.
families.explicit_difference_from_eventcard: Artifact is a collectable local-browser object with no event date, venue, admission or EventCard actions.

families.responsive_behavior: Auto-fit grid preserves semantic link versus disabled article and minimum 18rem card basis.
families.explicit_difference_from_eventcard: Collection card is an editorial route entry with lifecycle status, not an individual EventCard.

acceptance_criteria: Each family has a canonical master and linked review specimens on its own bounded page.
No family substitutes an EventCard clone.
Current source is authoritative; donor facts never carry old Penpot IDs.
Second execution creates zero and preserves deterministic identities.
